correctness.rationale: The source information/check split is reconstructed from Example 3.5 and Proposition 3.7. Exactly three vertical fibers are wholly in the check set. Each Theorem 4.5 map translates first coordinate by a, so its covered vertical fibers are a translate of a fixed three-point subset \(T\) of a four-element \(\mathbb F_2\)-subspace \(W\). Sixteen affine W-cosets force at least two distinct translations per coset, hence at least 32 maps. The included exact verifier checks membership of the displayed 32 maps in the source family and exhaustively confirms coverage of all 8128 unordered coordinate pairs.

value.rationale: PD-set cardinality directly controls the number of automorphism/syndrome tests in the standard permutation-decoding procedure. For the source's explicit arbitrary-two-position example, replacing 128 maps by the exact restricted-family optimum 32 gives a fourfold worst-case reduction within the proposed method. The affine-fiber lower bound explains the optimum structurally rather than merely reporting a set-cover computation.
